newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on exports, contract highs.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on exports, contract highs.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher and new contract highs were set as a bullish export sector led the advance, traders said.
"The export sales were good," a trader said. "It puts us at a sales pace ahead of last year."
USDA said Friday U.S. rice exports for the week ended Jan 16 totaled 120,900 tonnes, above expectations for 60,000 to 65,000 tonnes.
Also, traders said there was commercial buying on the open, reflecting overnight business.
The new contract high for March is $11.99 per cwt, up from $11.75 Thursday.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 900 contracts, above the 780 traded Thursday.
Rice futures closed five to 17-1/2 cents higher, with March up 17-1/2 at $11.89-1/2 per cwt.
